scope: Measurement, postprocessing and fixed-selector safety acceptance. No new relation learning, VLM calls or RL.
reference_definition: Same spatial union-of-swept-footprint mean exposure at 512, without intermediate area pooling. 256 is a resolution check. Not contact, q95 or physical damage probability.

e1.models: All five frozen independent-geometry checkpoints from prior study; no training
e1.boundary_diagnostic: One 16x16 pixel morphological band around each target support; oracle replaces only band values as a privileged mechanism diagnostic.
e1.simple_fix_flag: Restored-zero raw acceptance has conditional unsafe <=0.05 and eta>=0.5 on both consumed IID and appearance datasets under common reference. Diagnostic only; do not invent a novel safety mechanism if true.

training.checkpoint: final step 960; no early stopping or validation selection

e2.geometry_sampling: Continuous geometry and property assignment frozen before rasterization. Anchor uses randomized left/right properties in legacy-like ellipses; independent uses freely located/rotated ellipses and boxes. Continuous bounding-circle nonoverlap/in-frame checks, never raster-based rejection. Same anonymous independent path sampler in both conditions. This is a geometry-scheme contrast, not isolation of position alone.
e2.rendering: Same 64x64 RGB bytes within each geometry scene across both training source rasters. Output fields always 16x16. Candidate paths and property assignments fixed across source rasters.
e2.primary_scoring: All arms use identical 512-derived area-pooled query footprints and direct 512 mean-exposure truth; also report native source-pooled fields/footprints and 256 reference.
e2.primary_contrast: Balanced-anchor minus independent mean A/C/D regret on fresh appearance under common reference, separately for each source raster.
e2.decision: Geometry claim supported only if both crossed 95% interval lower endpoints exceed 0.001. Resolution contrasts entirely within +/-0.0005 count as practically equivalent; overlapping zero is inconclusive. No grid/checkpoint search.

e3.component: All five independent-geometry / source-64 final checkpoints from E2, chosen a priori; no winning-seed/model selection
e3.main_selector: Restored-zero formula; choose minimum predicted cost with ties at 1e-9 resolved by one stored independent uniform variate; choose once, then accept/reject; no reselection
e3.deployment: Each independent scene samples one image variant with probability 1/2 and one card uniformly from A/C/D; one Bernoulli safety outcome per scene for certification
e3.certification: Finite threshold bank uses one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson bounds with Bonferroni delta=0.05/(5 models*2 calibration domains*12 rules). Select highest-coverage certified rule; ties choose smallest threshold. No rule certification if accepted count is zero. Thresholds change acceptance only; truth danger remains cost>0.02.
e3.freeze: Persist selector/rule bank and checkpoint hashes after development and before calibration. Persist certificates before opening final test data. Source-certified rules on target test are shift stress tests; target-certified rules use explicitly labeled target adaptation.
e3.primary_gate: Every IID model has a valid <=5% certificate under the family correction AND crossed seed/scene 95% lower bound on safe acceptance efficiency eta>=0.50. Test risk is reported separately. No zero-shot target guarantee.
e3.eta: P(accepted AND actual selected cost<=0.02)/P(at least one supplied candidate cost<=0.02). Unsafe accepts never count toward eta.

bootstrap.unit: Independently resample paired model seeds and scenes, preserving all condition/variant/card dependence; E3 uses one deployed decision per scene

stopping: If reference resolution gate fails, stop before training/confirmation and repair measurement precision
If oracle feasibility is below 0.5, stop policy-certification expansion
If simple postprocessing meets diagnostic safety/usefulness, report a simple repair rather than new mechanism; keep it as E3 strong baseline
After the frozen 20-run factorial and one final certification test, report failure/inconclusive without expanding architectures, thresholds or test reuse
execution: All numerical work in Quest Slurm allocations. New immutable outputs; preserve historical sources and results. No outside messages, VLM calls or RL jobs.
